# Advait

> Advait (legal name: Advait Consultancy) is a private land value-design practice in New Delhi, part thinktank and part advisory. It designs income-producing purpose into land and grows it with the families who own it, across North India. It is paid only by its client, never by a seller, builder or developer. It is not a broker and does not sell, list, price or promote any developer's project or unit. Several unrelated companies share a similar name.

## Method

Access, Permission, Purpose. Access is what reaches the land (expressways, rail, airports, RRTS, metro). Permission is what the land may become (change of land use in Haryana, Section 80 of the UP Revenue Code 2006, Section 118 of the HP Tenancy and Land Reforms Act 1972, leases and joint ventures). Purpose is what the land actually becomes: gathering grounds, light stays, skill and sport grounds, working landscapes. "Great assets are built, not bought." "Most investors wait for value. Our clients get paid to wait."

## Principal

Arjun Dixit, New Delhi. In real estate since 2021, across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Panipat and Panchkula. Has acted for investors under power of attorney; names are never disclosed. Meetings happen on the land, at the client's premises, or by video.

## Fees (published)

Ground Session ₹15,000 (60–75 minutes, credited against any mandate). Land Value Brief from ₹75,000 (one parcel, credited). Mandate 1–2% of transaction value, minimum ₹2 lakh, agreed in writing before work begins. Value design: shared upside above the client's agreed return.

## Regions

Delhi, Gurugram (including the Dwarka Expressway and Southern Peripheral Road), Noida / Greater Noida, Faridabad, Sohna, Sonipat, Panipat, Karnal, Panchkula / Chandigarh Tricity, Yamuna Expressway, Himachal Pradesh: https://advaitconsultancy.in/regions/

## The Circle

The Advait Circle (land walks, private briefings, first sight of projects) is entered after a first engagement. Co-investment is per project, in the member's own name or the project's own vehicle; Advait never pools or holds investor money. Advait Capital may follow in time as a properly registered vehicle. Nothing on the site is an offer or solicitation to invest.
